title: A character performs, in their own voice (LTX-2.3 ID-LoRA)
description: LTX-2.3 with the ID-LoRA: the character from the image speaks and moves in one pass, in the voice of the audio sample (it clones the voice from 3-10 s of the character speaking), lips, face, body and sound made together. Write the prompt as [VISUAL]: the shot, the action, the expression; [SPEECH]: the exact words; [SOUNDS]: the tone, room and effects. For a character talking to camera or a close-up performance; video.scene for two people in one room.

image.description: The character (the first frame: framing, look, light)

audio.description: A clean sample of the character's voice (3-10 s, no music): the voice it speaks in

prompt.example:
[VISUAL]: Opens with a medium shot, camera slowly pushes in toward the character. A man with short dark hair and round glasses, wearing a retro orange floral shirt, looks directly at the camera, his mouth opens and closes naturally as he speaks, tilts his head playfully.
[SPEECH]: Hey, what do you think of this vibe? Feels like we’re back in the 90s.
[SOUNDS]: Playful and upbeat tone, moderate volume, close to the microphone.

negative.default: pc game, console game, video game, cartoon, childish, ugly

width.description: Width (1280 wide, 720 for a vertical short)

height.description: Height (720 wide, 1280 for a vertical short)

seed.description: Seed for the first output; the next ones count up. Random when empty.
